Independent reconstruction-only removal of acceleration while retaining all other acceleration-based feedback: not available in frozen engine.
Exact converter SINC3 transfer and separate converter output-noise versus sample-rate law.

event_scoring_convention: right-continuous ordinary endpoint; additional left limit; first invalid contact side stops at that time
rigid_contact_interpretation: The ideal rigid 77 mm plate has acceleration transitions with a force-error floor of 1.2*mass_s N across one-sided limits. A heavy rigid-bank force failure is not evidence that converter precision or sample rate alone caused it. Separate fixed-controller sensitivities from this mechanical limit.
calibration_scope: One-at-a-time positive force/acceleration bias and +/-1% identified S mass. Finite sensitivities, not bounds on a joint residual box; true mechanics and loaded equilibrium stay unchanged. Identified mass affects inertia reconstruction, controller gravity compensation and SEA body-position estimate; the acquisition gravity tare remains nominal and exact.
scope: Fixed-controller acquisition response diagnostics on the newest one-axis no-drag axial model, for both actuators with and without the 5 mm pad. Finite diagnostics do not qualify chip transfer, calibration, thermal duty, engagement, robot recentering or sanding surface-normal force.
